text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

words.gloss_range: assertive particle governing the opening nominal clause and establishing emphatic certainty
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens by making the Hour claim an asserted certainty rather than a premise left for debate. Its scope reaches the coming predicate and the no-doubt confirmation, so the middle clause confirms an already installed frame. The compact doubled particle also frontloads pressure before any lexical content appears, matching an audience whose non-belief will soon be named.

topics.headline: scoped certainty opener
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening assertion governs both the arrival claim and the no-doubt confirmation.
topics.reason: The particle opens the main asserted clause and the attachment evidence treats the no-doubt clause as explaining the same certainty frame.

topics.headline: frontloaded formal pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis is packed into the very first form before the named event appears.
topics.reason: The surface is a compact annulling particle with doubled consonantal pressure, matching its opening role as emphatic governor.

topics.headline: stacked confirmation against resistance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first confirmer anticipates the later predicate emphasis and the final diagnosis of resistance.
topics.reason: The opening assertion and the later predicate emphasis form a stacked confirmation pattern before the clause names majority non-belief.

words.gloss_range: definite appointed Hour as a governed event-subject; not generic time or an unrelated root branch
words.root_gloss_range: time, measured interval, appointed moment, and eschatological Hour; locally the definite coming Hour with bounded appointment pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّاعَةَ}} ({{tr:al-sāʿata}}) is the governed subject of the assertion and the antecedent resumed in the no-doubt phrase. Its definiteness makes the event a recognized appointment, while the time-measure root keeps the appointment bounded rather than vague futurity. The word anchors the arrival, the exclusion of doubt, and the later test of human response around one eschatological event. The close Hour-coming-no-doubt formula appears with resurrection proof at 22:7; here it is extended into the problem of majority non-belief.

topics.headline: governed event anchor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one fronted event anchors both arrival and the exclusion of doubt.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the governed subject of the assertion and the no-doubt phrase resumes the same event.

topics.headline: definite appointed Hour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word selects a recognized appointment with measured-time pressure, not vague time in general.
topics.reason: Definiteness and the eschatological predicate select the appointed Hour sense; wider root branches are not locally active.

topics.headline: certainty formula becomes response test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar Hour-coming-no-doubt formula being extended into a test of human response, especially against 22:7.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence rows link the Hour with coming and doubt-denial, while 22:7 supplies the close formula that 40:59 extends with majority non-belief.

words.gloss_range: bound predicate-emphasis particle focused on the coming predicate; no independent lexical motion
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) adds a second pressure point to the opening assertion by fastening emphasis directly to the coming predicate. The reader hears certainty before the arrival word itself, so the predicate is not a weak prediction. Its one-letter form also creates a sharp beat at the threshold of the predicate.

topics.headline: predicate-focused emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the certainty pressure lands specifically on the coming predicate.
topics.reason: The particle is licensed by the preceding assertion frame and attached to the predicate, so it reinforces the coming claim rather than adding lexical content.

topics.headline: emphatic beat before predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a separate audible beat of certainty immediately before the arrival word.
topics.reason: The split word ID and bound prefix form make the listener pass through a brief emphatic marker before the predicate onset.

words.gloss_range: feminine active participle naming the Hour as surely coming; not a finite narrated arrival
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and realization; locally narrowed to the Hour as a standing incoming reality
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتِيَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʾātiyatun}}) is a feminine active participle serving as the predicate of the asserted clause. It makes coming a standing attribute of the Hour, not just a future finite action, and its agreement keeps that incomingness tied to the named event. The root field adds realized arrival and coming-to-pass, while local grammar keeps the selected sense on arrival rather than unrelated giving branches. Formulaic echoes such as 15:85 and 22:7 make the certainty recognizable, and the hard onset plus cadence gives the predicate audible firmness.

topics.headline: standing participial predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that coming is presented as a standing characterization of the Hour, not merely as a dated future verb.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a feminine active participle serving as predicate of the asserted clause; agreement binds it to the Hour.

topics.headline: realized arrival field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices arrival as realization and coming-to-pass, while the local predicate keeps the sense from spreading into unrelated branches.
topics.reason: The root family supports coming, bringing, and realization; local form and subject select the arrival-coming branch, with giving only a contrastive boundary.

topics.headline: Hour-coming formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the arrival predicate participates in a recognizable certainty formula, including 15:85, and is locally sharpened toward non-belief.
topics.reason: Rows point to same-root and cross-surah formulae; 15:85 is a direct Hour-coming assertion and 40:59 extends the formula into a reception contrast.

topics.headline: sound and emphasis converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that form, emphatic pressure, and sound all converge on the arrival predicate.
topics.reason: The predicate follows the emphatic particle with a hard onset and cadence; the summary row explicitly joins participial form, emphatic stack, and sound.

words.gloss_range: categorical negator before an indefinite doubt noun, excluding the class of doubt
words.prose: {{ar:لَّا}} ({{tr:lā}}) begins the no-doubt clause by excluding a whole category, not by denying one private hesitation. Its construction before the indefinite doubt noun differs from the later verbal negation, so the ayah first removes doubt from the event and only later denies belief of people. The immediate, connectorless move from assertion to negation makes the confirmation terse and categorical.

topics.headline: categorical doubt negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah excludes the category of doubt around the Hour before diagnosing people.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation-support evidence mark the particle as categorical negation governing the following indefinite doubt noun.

topics.headline: first negator form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first negator is formally and rhythmically distinct from the later verbal negator.
topics.reason: The surface before a noun differs from the later particle before a verb, and the rows identify this as a visible and audible contrast.

words.gloss_range: doubt, suspicion, misgiving, and disquiet as a denied disturbance around the Hour
words.root_gloss_range: disturbing uncertainty, suspicion, and unsettled confidence; locally the entire class of such disturbance is excluded
words.prose: {{ar:رَيْبَ}} ({{tr:rayba}}) names the disturbance that has no place around the Hour. Its indefinite accusative form under categorical negation excludes any instance of that doubt, while the compact no-doubt clause omits an overt existential for speed and force. The accepted rayban variant keeps the denial intact but makes the exclusion of any single instance of doubt more audible. The lexical field is not neutral inquiry but suspicion and disquiet; the recognized no-doubt formula appears in contexts such as 2:2 and 22:7, here turned toward the problem of human non-belief.

topics.headline: class-negated doubt noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun is grammatically positioned so no instance of doubt is available in relation to the Hour.
topics.reason: The word is an indefinite accusative verbal noun after categorical negation, with the following prepositional phrase completing the no-doubt assertion.

topics.headline: disturbance not neutral inquiry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied doubt is unsettling suspicion and disquiet, not honest inquiry.
topics.reason: The lexical field includes doubt, suspicion, and unsettled certainty; local negation excludes this disturbance while unrelated time-reversal senses are not selected.

topics.headline: variant sharpens indefiniteness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accepted variant keeps the denial intact while making any individual instance of doubt more audible.
topics.reason: The variant remains accusative and preserves the no-doubt claim; it foregrounds indefiniteness rather than changing the local meaning.

topics.headline: no-doubt formula echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a known no-doubt formula from 2:2 and 22:7 is applied to the Hour and then answered by the unbelief clause.
topics.reason: Rows explicitly cite 2:2 and 22:7 as no-doubt formula contexts, with 40:59 applying the formula to the Hour before turning to majority refusal.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus feminine suffix, in it or concerning it, resuming the Hour as the no-doubt domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) fastens the denied doubt back to the Hour without repeating the noun. The preposition can mark both location and concern, so the phrase says doubt has no valid place in the event and no valid standing with respect to it. By arriving after the doubt noun, the pronoun snaps the exclusion back to the opening subject and completes the compressed no-doubt clause. Against the little reflection named just before this ayah (40:58), the pronoun locates the answer in the Hour's own domain.

topics.headline: pronoun routes back to the Hour
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the no-doubt phrase remains anchored to the same event instead of drifting into a vague claim.
topics.reason: The feminine suffix agrees with the Hour and is governed by the preposition as the complement attached to the doubt noun.

topics.headline: domain of exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that doubt is denied within and concerning the Hour as a bounded domain.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase completes the compressed no-doubt clause and marks the domain or topic in which doubt has no standing.

topics.headline: boundary answer to failed recollection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prior failure of recollection in 40:58 is answered by locating doubt outside the Hour’s domain in 40:59.
topics.reason: The boundary row links little reflection in 40:58 to the no-doubt claim in 40:59, with the pronoun phrase anchoring the contrast.

words.gloss_range: connective particle carrying the discourse into an adversative contrast
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not let the final clause float away as a separate topic. It connects the adversative turn to the certainty already built, making the majority’s unbelief a response against what has just been established. Its brief form gives the line a light reset before the heavier contrast particle. It also carries the shift from the second-person challenge in 40:58 into third-person public diagnosis.

topics.headline: connected adversative hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final contrast is attached to the certainty frame rather than introduced as a separate issue.
topics.reason: The conjunction precedes the adversative particle and the attachment evidence treats the following clause as contrastive under the main assertion.

topics.headline: fused transition form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a tiny attached connector creates the audible reset into contrast.
topics.reason: The rows identify the particle as a single-letter proclitic attached to the adversative word, with a brief rhythmic reset before the pivot.

topics.headline: register shift carrier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from prior direct address into third-person public diagnosis.
topics.reason: The boundary row marks a shift from second-person challenge in 40:58 to third-person assertion and indictment in 40:59.

words.gloss_range: adversative annulling particle that governs the majority phrase and redirects from certainty to reception
words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}) is the ayah’s main pivot from the Hour’s status to human reception. It governs the majority phrase and delays the negative predicate, so the people are placed before the failure is named. The particle corrects the expected inference that certainty should produce belief: the problem is not the event’s reality, but the majority’s response to it. Its heavy annulling-particle profile echoes the opening assertion frame while reversing expectation.

topics.headline: adversative governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the contrast is grammatically organized as a new governed clause about majority reception.
topics.reason: The particle governs the majority phrase as its subject and takes the later negated verbal clause as predicate.

topics.headline: counterexpectation pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the expected inference being reversed: certainty does not become majority belief.
topics.reason: The adversative particle follows maximal certainty and redirects the discourse from the event’s status to people’s failed response.

topics.headline: annulling-particle parallel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final pivot echoing the opening governed assertion while reversing its direction.
topics.reason: The form shares the heavy annulling-particle profile of the opener but uses that profile to introduce contrast.

words.gloss_range: elative construct meaning the greater part or most of the people; dominance without totality
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, increase, multiplication, and comparative excess; locally a majority measure, not proof or universality
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرَ}} ({{tr:akthara}}) makes the new clause begin with quantity of reception. In construct with the people, it names most of the human field without erasing a minority, so numbers diagnose resistance rather than disprove the Hour. The same majority formula echoes 12:103 and nearby 40:57, where the predicate is knowing rather than believing, tightening the movement from cognition to trust-response. Its hamza-kaf-tha-r texture gives the pivot's first content word a counted, percussive feel that suits the quantifier.

topics.headline: construct majority subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the pivot’s subject is most of a defined human field, not an undefined many.
topics.reason: The elative is governed by the adversative particle and forms a construct with the people, giving the negative predicate a quantified subject.

topics.headline: majority not totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices numerical dominance without the erasure of a believing minority.
topics.reason: The elative and construct grammar select greater share within a field; broader abundance and rivalry branches supply pressure but not universality or proof.

topics.headline: majority diagnosis formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the majority formula links 12:103 and 40:57 to this ayah’s move from knowing to believing.
topics.reason: Rows cite 12:103 and 40:57 and identify a recurring majority-human-belief diagnosis, locally placed after certainty about the Hour.

topics.headline: percussive quantifier sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pivot’s first content word arriving with a counted, forceful sound.
topics.reason: The phonetic row ties the consonant texture to the word’s quantifying role at the start of the pivot.

words.gloss_range: definite human collective as genitive complement of the majority expression
words.root_gloss_range: human social familiarity, peoplehood, perception, and debated relation to forgetting; locally the known collective human field
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) completes the construct phrase by naming the human domain from which the majority is measured. The definite collective keeps the diagnosis social and shared, not a list of isolated individuals. Its human root field lets the failure feel like estrangement from a reality people should recognize, and the recurrence with 40:57 binds not-knowing and not-believing into one surah-local human diagnosis. The article's assimilation into nūn also binds the collective acoustically into the majority phrase and the final plural response.

topics.headline: genitive human domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are the measured domain of the majority expression before they become the predicate’s actors.
topics.reason: The word is the genitive complement of the elative majority head, completing the subject phrase before the negated predicate arrives.

topics.headline: human social field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the human collective as a social field whose reception is estranged from certainty.
topics.reason: The root field supports social humanity, familiarity, and perception pressure; the local noun remains the known human collective, while the root dispute is kept as a sharpening contrast rather than a replacement.

topics.headline: collective response pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same human collective linked to not knowing in 40:57 is now linked to not believing.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and echo rows connect the people with majority and belief roots, while agreement with the final plural verb turns the collective into a communal response pattern.

topics.headline: assimilated sound thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the human collective being acoustically bound into the majority phrase and the final response.
topics.reason: The rows mark article assimilation and a recurring nasal sound thread linking assertion, contrast, people, and the final verb.

words.gloss_range: verbal negation before an indicative imperfect, denying belief as a present or habitual predicate
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the final imperfect verb as a reported state or habit, not as a prohibition. Its scope falls on belief, not on the existence of the majority group. As the second negation in the ayah, it mirrors the earlier no-doubt negation while changing the target: the Hour lacks doubt, while most people lack belief.

topics.headline: verbal negation as diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause reports ongoing non-belief rather than issuing a command or narrating a completed past denial.
topics.reason: The particle negates an indicative imperfect predicate, with scope over the action-state of belief rather than over the subject phrase.

topics.headline: paired negation contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s two negations measuring two different absences: no doubt in the event, no belief in most people.
topics.reason: The first particle negates a noun class and the second negates an imperfect verb; the repeated form creates a structural comparison without collapsing the functions.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect of believing, trusting, or entering secure acknowledgment, with no explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: security, trust, assurance, belief, and entrustment; locally Form IV marks absent secure acknowledgment by the majority
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْمِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾminūna}}) closes the ayah with the missing response. The imperfect form presents non-belief as ongoing or habitual, and its plural agreement ties the failure back to the majority group. Because the expected object is omitted, the charge broadens beyond one named object to the Hour, warning, unseen reality, and trust itself. The root field makes the failure more than bare assent: most people do not enter secure acknowledgment, so the final word lands on reception after certainty has already been secured. That landing recasts the majority-reception pattern of 12:103 and the nearby not-knowing formula in 40:57 as a trust-response failure; after failed recollection in 40:58, the next ayah answers with a direct command to call in 40:60.

topics.headline: ongoing plural non-belief
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final failure is ongoing and communal, tied by agreement to the majority group.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an imperfect plural indicative verb; attachment evidence resolves the predicate to the majority subject without an overt separate subject.

topics.headline: object omission broadens the charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the missing object widens the failure beyond one named item to the whole trust-response demanded by the ayah.
topics.reason: The verb commonly takes a complement but none appears locally, so the failure remains open toward the Hour, warning, unseen reality, and trust itself.

topics.headline: trust-security field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-belief is a failure to enter secure acknowledgment, not merely failure to process a proposition.
topics.reason: The root field includes safety, trust, assurance, and belief; local Form IV selects believing or entering trust, not merely being safe in Form I.

topics.headline: formula and surah movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 40:59 recasting majority-reception formulas, especially 12:103 and 40:57, from concern or knowing into trust-response.
topics.reason: Rows cite 12:103, 40:51, 40:57, and the next-ayah command; together they make the final verb the trust-response counterpart to prior knowledge and recollection failures.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَآتِيَةٌ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The emphatic construction predicates the Hour as an arriving agent, then excludes the agitated uncertainty of r-y-b. Certainty is thus represented as movement toward its recipients, not merely as a proposition about a date.

activation_trace.role: Coming and reaching supplies forward motion, making futurity an arrival already oriented toward the hearer.
Agitated doubt and suspicion are explicitly excluded, removing an unstable posture toward that arrival.

changed_reading.before: The Hour will happen sometime, and one should not doubt that statement.
changed_reading.after: The Hour is construed as an arrival advancing toward its recipients; doubt is denied as instability that cannot suspend its movement.

baseline_models.mechanism: Numerical abundance modifies the visible human collective, while faith combines crediting the announcement with heart-settling security. The line diagnoses social abundance without corresponding inner settlement.

activation_trace.role: Growth in number supplies the many whose aggregate response is being diagnosed.
The manifest human collective supplies a shared social field rather than isolated private doubters.
Security and trusted repose supply the inward settlement that the majority lacks.
Heart-assured crediting supplies the report-directed dimension of the same missing response.

changed_reading.before: Most people do not assent to the prediction.
changed_reading.after: The expanding human mass does not let the announced arrival become trusted inner security, so numerical commonness coexists with unsettled hearts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, the arriving Hour gathers a functional sequence: nearness, exposure, standing, witnessed presence, and the cessation of excuses' usefulness. Its coming is a public transition in what can remain hidden and what can still benefit a person.

activation_trace.role: The focus arrival is the temporal motion to which the contextual functions are attached.
Emergence and exposure supply the public visibility produced at the arriving event.
Drawing near converts the future event from remote chronology into pressure at the present edge.
The branch explicitly joins resurrection and the Hour's standing, supplying the event's phase change.
Presence with witnessing supplies the public evidentiary field in which the event stands.
The negated benefit of excuses supplies the functional cutoff created by that public standing.

structural_cues: 40:15 names a coming occasion as يَوْمَ التَّلَاقِ.
40:16-18 move from exposure to an event described as near, with hearts at throats.
40:46 contrasts recurring morning-and-evening exposure with the day the Hour stands.
40:51-52 place standing witnesses and failed excuses on that day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, exposure, standing, witness-presence, and failed benefit; I infer that these are successive functions of the focus Hour's arrival. They could instead be parallel depictions of the broader judgment scene rather than a strict sequence.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is a certain future point.
changed_reading.after: The Hour arrives as the near public standing that exposes persons, installs witnessing, and closes the period in which an excuse can still help.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated frame 'be patient; God's promise is fixed' surrounds the focus, and the later frame separates fulfillment from the addressee's lifespan: he may be shown part of it or have his life fully taken before all are returned. 'No doubt' becomes practical reliance on fulfillment independent of personal observation.

activation_trace.role: The focus excludes destabilizing doubt about fulfillment.
Holding the self back from panic supplies the practical posture demanded by delayed fulfillment.
A promise that opens expectation supplies the interpersonal basis of certainty.
Fixed obligation and deserved necessity supply the promise's nonoptional completion.
Causing the addressee to see supplies one possible, but explicitly nonessential, mode of witnessing fulfillment.
Taking the soul fully supplies the alternative in which the witness's lifespan ends first.
Return supplies the convergence that still completes the promise beyond individual observation.

structural_cues: 40:55 places patience and the fixed promise immediately before the focus neighborhood.
40:77 repeats the same opening and then gives seeing and death as alternatives.
The later clause ends not in failed fulfillment but in universal return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patience, a fixed promise, optional seeing, completed death, and return; I infer that the certainty of 40:59 is covenantal reliability that outlives the witness. The live alternative is that the promise language concerns nearer victories while only analogically strengthening the Hour.

changed_reading.before: No doubt means that the proposition has overwhelming evidence.
changed_reading.after: No doubt also means that fulfillment does not depend on whether this hearer lives to watch it; patience rests on a promise completed across death and return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The 40:57-61 sequence repeats 'most people' around a chain of response failures: cosmic scale is not known, blind and seeing are not equal, recollection is scarce, the Hour is not trusted, and daily favor is not acknowledged. The majority phrase marks a recurring bottleneck from perception through memory to trust and gratitude.

activation_trace.role: Numerical abundance begins the local parallel by quantifying those who fail to know.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the first response capacity that the majority fails to realize.
Inner sight supplies the discernment placed between failed knowledge and failed trust.
Recollection after forgetfulness supplies the scarce mediating act immediately before the focus.
Heart-assured crediting is the focus response that fails after the preceding failures of discernment and recollection.
The same numerical construction resumes two verses later and makes the parallel diagnostic rather than incidental.
Recognition of favor and praise of its giver supplies the final response that most people withhold.

structural_cues: 40:57 and 40:61 use the same وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا construction as 40:59.
40:58 inserts the unequal blind/seeing contrast and says recollection is little.
40:61 places the second majority formula after night-rest, day-visibility, and divine favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the tight repeated syntax and the capacities knowing, seeing, remembering, trusting, and thanking; I supply the directional chain among them. They may instead be coordinated diagnoses with no fixed psychological order.

changed_reading.before: Most people happen not to accept one eschatological claim.
changed_reading.after: Their nonbelief is the central link in a repeated response failure: mis-scaled knowledge and dim recollection do not become trust, just as experienced daily favor does not become gratitude.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, call and answer present a live reciprocal opening that arrogance refuses. At the surah's close, sight of overwhelming force finally produces a declaration of faith, but that faith no longer benefits. Faith is therefore temporally meaningful as an uncoerced response before arrival changes the conditions of knowing.

activation_trace.role: Assured crediting anchors the response whose timing the context changes.
The spoken call supplies an open relational initiative immediately after the focus.
Answering speech supplies reciprocal availability while response is still possible.
Self-greatness supplies the posture that refuses that available relation.
Direct sight supplies the coercive evidentiary condition under which late acknowledgment appears.
Overwhelming force supplies what converts disputed warning into unavoidable perception.
The same faith branch now occurs only after sight of force, exposing a timing contrast with the focus.
Negated benefit marks the point at which acknowledgment can no longer perform faith's prior function.

structural_cues: 40:60 follows the focus with 'call Me; I will answer you' and contrasts this with arrogant refusal of worship.
40:84 reports faith only after direct sight of divine force.
40:85 explicitly says that this faith did not benefit them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an open call-answer relation, arrogant refusal, compelled sight, late faith, and lost benefit; I infer that the Hour's coming is the threshold between trust and mere forced recognition. A live alternative is a juridical cutoff without a claim about faith's psychology.

changed_reading.before: Most people currently lack belief, but they may simply revise that opinion when the Hour appears.
changed_reading.after: The failure is to answer in trust while response is open; once force is seen, acknowledgment can occur yet no longer do the beneficial work of faith.

context_deltas.mechanism: The life-stage sequence reaches an appointed term; divine decision then effects an affair by command. Later, even a messenger cannot bring a sign without permission, whereas when God's command comes, judgment is executed in truth. The Hour's arrival is recast as appointed and authorized completion rather than autonomous chronological drift.

activation_trace.role: The focus supplies the arrival whose mode of execution the context specifies.
A prescribed temporal limit supplies an appointed endpoint to the preceding life stages.
Effective completion and execution supply the directional force from decision to realized event.
The affair supplies the object brought from decision into presence.
Occurrence and presence in time supply the immediate realization expressed by 'Be, and it is.'
A messenger's inability to bring a sign independently supplies a contrast between arrival and authorization.
Permission supplies the authorization governing the arrival of a sign.
Coming and obtaining supply the moment when the divine command reaches execution.
Cutting judgment supplies the decisive operation performed when the command arrives.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the mode in which that judgment is executed.

structural_cues: 40:67 moves through repeated life stages and ends at a named appointed term.
40:68 links deciding an affair to the performative sequence 'Be, and it is.'
40:78 contrasts a messenger's permission-bound bringing with the coming of God's command and immediate judgment in truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointed limit, effective decision, permission, command-arrival, and judgment; I align these as the causal grammar of the focus Hour. The alternative is that the passages independently demonstrate power and authorization without specifying the Hour's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The Hour comes as an impersonal event on a future timeline.
changed_reading.after: Its coming is the appointed completion of ordered stages and the authorized arrival of a command that becomes decisive reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah twice orders inspection of earlier peoples and measures them by strength and durable traces; the later instance adds that they were more numerous, yet their acquisitions did not suffice. The 'most people' of the focus therefore cannot function as an evidentiary vote against the Hour.

activation_trace.role: Competition and dominance by number supply the tempting but rejected social warrant of the majority.
Concentrated strength supplies one visible measure by which earlier peoples seemed secure.
A durable mark of what was supplies material evidence of former power.
Being more numerous makes the historical counterexample directly revise the focus majority.
Negated sufficiency removes protective force from numerical, material, and historical abundance.
Acquired gain supplies the accumulated resource that nevertheless fails to protect.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat the travel-look question and compare prior peoples by force and traces.
40:82 adds that those peoples were more numerous.
The same ayah denies that what they acquired availed them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated historical inspection in which greater number, force, traces, and gain fail; I infer that this strips majority status of epistemic authority in 40:59. The alternative is a narrower warning about worldly protection rather than truth assessment.

changed_reading.before: Most people's unbelief is merely a sad statistic.
changed_reading.after: The statistic is polemical: even a numerically dominant population with strength, remains, and gains cannot make its nonbelief a warrant against the arriving Hour.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 40:34, clear signs had come, yet people remained in doubt and used Joseph's death to declare that no messenger would be raised afterward; the person is then named murtab. The focus reverses that closure: the Hour is coming, and the r-y-b posture cannot use an ended past to foreclose a future arrival.

activation_trace.role: The focus arrival directly overturns the contextual attempt to close off further coming.
Negated doubt anchors the revision of the earlier murtab posture.
Repeated coming supplies the prior arrivals that failed to dislodge doubt.
Perishing supplies the past endpoint from which the doubters infer a closed future.
Sending and directing a messenger supplies the future possibility that the speakers deny.
The same agitated doubt branch labels the posture that converts one death into a claim about all future sending.
The absent compelling warrant exposes the disputers' closure as unsupported.
What has not come to the disputers is warrant for their claim, in contrast to the Hour that emphatically will come.

structural_cues: 40:34 repeats 'came' around continued doubt, then moves from Joseph's death to a categorical denial of later sending.
The ayah closes by naming the excessive doubter مُرْتَاب.
40:35 says the disputers possess no authority that came to them, while 40:59 emphatically predicates the Hour as coming.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior coming, continued doubt, death, denial of later sending, and absent warrant; I infer a temporal-closure mechanism that the focus overturns. The alternative is that 40:34 targets prophetic succession only and informs the Hour no more than by analogy.

changed_reading.before: There is no generic intellectual uncertainty about the Hour.
changed_reading.after: The verse rejects a recurrent temporal mistake: treating what has ended or what has not yet been seen as authority to close the future against a coming event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers a hydrological subbranch of the focus root into eschatological arrival. It remains anchored because B005 belongs directly to focus ء-ت-ي and 40:13 supplies descent, sky, and rain-as-provision. Downstream prose should present it only as a process analogy, not as a lexical replacement for آتِيَة.

activation_trace.role: A flood arriving from a rain-struck land into an un-rained land supplies an arrival whose source can be outside local perception.
Bringing something down and delivering it supplies the vertical source-to-recipient path.
The overhanging sky supplies the source region from which the provision descends.
Rain descending as provision makes the packet's hydrological process explicit enough to activate the focus subbranch.

changed_reading.before: The Hour sits at a fixed future coordinate waiting to be reached.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its coming resembles runoff from rain elsewhere: a process can cross the horizon into an apparently dry local field before recipients have witnessed its source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it turns a dust-cloud branch of abundance into a cognitive image. It remains anchored in focus أَكْثَرَ and is activated by the adjacent blind/seeing contrast. Downstream prose should label it a cross-domain metaphor, never claim that أَكْثَر literally means blindness or dust here.

activation_trace.role: Dust becoming abundant, rising, and spreading supplies a material image for accumulation that impairs a field of view.
The same abundance branch in the immediately preceding majority formula extends the image across the local sequence.
Blindness of heart and insight supplies the cognitive loss of visibility.
Inner sight supplies the contrasting capacity that the accumulated cloud figuratively obstructs.

changed_reading.before: The majority is only a count of separate unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, accumulated opinion behaves like rising dust: the mass itself can become a shared visibility condition that makes trusting sight harder.

strongest_changes: The Hour's certainty became a near public standing that exposes, witnesses, and ends the usefulness of excuses.
No doubt became reliance on a fixed promise whose fulfillment does not depend on the present witness surviving to see it.
The 40:57-61 majority parallel turned nonbelief into one stage in a knowing-seeing-remembering-trusting-thanking response failure.
The close of the surah made faith time-sensitive: acknowledgment after compelled sight remains possible but no longer benefits.
Appointed term, effective command, permission, and judgment recast arrival as authorized completion rather than impersonal drift.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly changed the same focus constructions through exact lexical returns: coming versus warrant that never came, doubt versus the murtab's false closure, and 'most people' across knowledge, faith, and gratitude. The retained models therefore coexist as temporal, relational, juridical, and epistemic mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The public-standing model may partly unpack a conventional قيام الساعة collocation rather than disclose a separate mechanism.
The 40:57-61 capacities may be parallel diagnoses rather than a directional psychological sequence.
The promise passages can concern nearer promised outcomes while strengthening the Hour only analogically.
The runoff and dust-cloud outliers are branch-anchored but intentionally cross-domain and should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Arrival is certain while trust remains unsettled.** `ء ت ي/B001` gives coming and arrival; `ر ي ب/B001` gives disturbing doubt and is negated; `ء م ن/B001` gives settled security and trust but is denied of most people. I infer a distinction between objective trajectory and subjective settlement. The ayah reads disbelief as failure to become secure in a fixed arrival, not uncertainty in the event itself.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The sight-triggered faith of 40:84 and its uselessness in 40:85 reveal why earlier trust matters: arrival can become visible only after faith’s viable interval closes.

Doubt's role is explicitly denied of the event while lack of trust remains located in people. The packet gives that grammatical separation; I infer that disbelief does not make the event indeterminate. The ayah reads as a relocation of uncertainty from what comes to the perceivers who refuse to confirm it.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, develeri gözetimsiz bırakınca kendi yönlerine gitmelerini, bir dişi hayvanın otlakta dolaşmasını, yavrusunu terk etmesini ve malı ziyan etmeyi açıkça bir araya getirir. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yansıtır ve hayvan ile mal arasındaki katılımcı ayrımları koruyarak kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, hayvanı gözetimsiz bırakıp başıboş gitmesine yol açmaktır; genel kayıp ve mal savurma anlamları bunun kapsam genişlemeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, develeri veya bir dişi hayvanı gözetimsiz bırakıp kendi yönlerine gitmelerine yol açmayı anlatır. Bu çekirdekten bir şeyi kaybetme, malı savurma, otlakta başıboş dolaşma ve bir ana hayvanın yavrusunu yırtıcıya açık biçimde bırakması anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Hayvanlar gözetimsiz bırakılır ve bunun sonucu kendi yönlerine gidip başıboş kalırlar.
Gözetimsiz bırakma düşüncesi bir şeyi kaybetme veya malı savurma anlamına genişler.
Belirli bir dişi hayvan nitelemesi, otlakta kendi başına uzaklaşan hayvanı gösterir.
Aynı hayvan nitelemesi, yavrusunu yırtıcının yiyebileceği biçimde gözetimsiz bırakan anayı da gösterir.
İnsan nitelemelerinde malını sürekli savuran ve ziyan eden kişi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı hayvanı gözetimsiz bırakma, hayvanın kendi yönüne gitmesi ve bu ilişkiden doğan kayıp düşüncesidir. Otlakta uzaklaşan dişi hayvan, yavrusunu bırakan ana ve malını savuran kişi bu çekirdeğin özel katılımcılarla kurulmuş görünümleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir yalın anlamdan çok, belirli kişi ve durum kalıplarında malı veya sözü çok olma, üzerinde çok sayıda istek ya da hak bulunma ve başkasının malıyla çok görünme kullanımlarını toplar. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımlar ortak bir yalın kök anlamı gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Her anlam kendi kalıbına bağlıdır; mal çokluğu, çok konuşma, çok sayıda istemle karşılaşma ve başkasının malıyla çok görünme birbirinin yerine geçmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda bir kişinin malının ya da sözünün çok olması, kendisinden iyilik isteyenlerin veya üzerindeki hakların çoğalması yahut başkasının malıyla kendini varlıklı göstermesidir. Bu kullanımlar yalnız bağlı oldukları kalıp içinde geçerlidir.

facets.statement: Belirli kişi ve durum kalıpları, malın, sözün, isteklerin veya hakların bir kişiye bağlı çokluğunu bildirir.
Başka bir kişi kalıbı, kadın veya erkeğin çok konuştuğunu bildirir.
Edilgen yapı, kişiden iyilik isteyenlerin veya onun üzerindeki hakların çokluğunu bildirir.
Bir başka kalıp, kişinin başkasının malına dayanarak kendini çok malı varmış gibi göstermesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kalıba göre mal çokluğu, çok konuşma, iyilik isteyenlerin veya hak sahiplerinin çoğalması ve başkasının malıyla varlıklı görünme anlamlarını verir; bunlar ortak çokluk öğesine rağmen ayrı kullanımlardır. Bir açıklamada hakların çoğalmasına kişinin elindekinin tükenmesi eşlik eder.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Irmak, bol iyilik ve cömert kişi ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmelerdir; ortak bağları olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesidir.

concept_map.definition: Olağanüstü bolluk bildiren özel bir sözlük birimi, cennetteki bir ırmağı veya bol ve büyük iyiliği adlandırır; kişi kalıbında ise iyiliği ve bağışı bol, cömert bir önderi niteler.

facets.statement: Sözlük birimi cennette bulunan ve başka ırmakların kendisinden ayrıldığı özel bir ırmağı adlandırır.
Sözlük biriminin ortak çekirdeği, ırmak, iyilik ve kişi kullanımlarını olağanüstü bolluk düşüncesine bağlar.
Kişi kalıbında iyiliği ve bağışı çok, cömert ve önder bir erkek nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar özel sözlük birimini cennetteki bir ırmak ve bol ya da büyük iyilik olarak açıklar; kişi için kullanıldığında cömertliği, önderliği, iyilik ve bağış bolluğunu bildirir. Bir açıklamada cennet ırmaklarının çoğunun ondan ayrıldığı, bir diğerinde ise bol iyiliğin Peygamber'e verildiği belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sözlük biriminin iki temel açıklamasını birlikte gösterir; kişi nitelemesi ayrıca bağlama bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişi veya şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Yakınlık ve sevinç, rahatlık veren kişi ya da şey ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvan kullanımları bu çekirdekten bağımlı biçimde açıklanabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal duygusal yakınlık, rahatlık ve bunları sağlayan varlıkları kapsar; insan türünün adı, duyusal fark etme ve insana bakan yan anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yabancılık duymama çekirdeği ile rahatlık veren kişi veya şey ve insana alışık hayvan gibi özelleşmiş biçimler ayrı katmanlarda tutulur; özel biçimler bütün dalı tanımlamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık, ürkme veya kaçınma duymayıp yakınlık, rahatlık ve sevinç hissetmeyi anlatır. Bu duyguyu veren kişi veya şeye ve insana alışık, saldırgan olmayan hayvana da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey karşısında yabancılık ve ürkme duygusunun kalkıp yakınlık, rahatlık veya sevinç oluşmasını anlatır.
Kişiye arkadaşlık ederek veya yanında bulunarak yabancılık duygusunu gideren kişi ya da şeyi adlandırır.
İnsana alışık ve saldırgan olmayan hayvanı, özellikle bu nitelikteki köpeği anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yabancılık ve kaçınmanın karşıtı olan yakınlık ve rahatlıktır. Bu durum birine alışıp onun yanında sevinmeyi, rahatlık veren kişi veya şeyi ve insana alışık saldırgan olmayan hayvanı kapsayacak biçimde genişler.

concept_gloss.text: yabancılık duymadan yakınlık ve rahatlık hissetme
concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin ürkütücü ve yabancı gelmemesi, tersine yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi anlatıldığında dalın çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yabancılığın kalkmasıyla oluşan yakınlık ve rahatlık bağını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Alışma sonucunda yabancılığın kalkmasını ve yakınlık oluşmasını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yakınlık ve güven veren kaynağın kişiyle sınırlı olmamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsandan kaçmayan ve ısırıp saldırmayan evcil ya da alışkın hayvan için kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal seçilmiş kişiler arasındaki arı, özel ve karşılıklı dostluk bağını anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yabancılığın kalkmasıyla doğan duygusal yakınlığı ve rahatlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan türünü, insan topluluğunu veya bu türden tek bir kişiyi adlandırır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل الإنس بمعنى البشر ولا الإيناس بمعنى الإبصار ولا الجانب الإنسي إلا بدليل.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأنس أنس الإنسان بالشيء إذا لم يستوحش منه (maqayis)؛ الإيناس خلاف الإيحاش والإنس خلاف الوحشة والأنيس المؤانس وكل ما يؤنس به (sihah)؛ أنست بفلان أي فرحت به والأنس والاستئناس هو التأنس وكلب أنوس نقيض العقور (tahdhib)؛ الأنس خلاف النفور ولكل ما يؤنس به (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin güvenilir çekirdeği, bir şeyin insana veya onu kullanan kişiye dönük ve yakın olan yanıdır. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı olduğu konusunda aktarımlar uyuşmaz; hayvan ve yay örnekleri yönü işlevsel ilişkiyle belirler. Bu nedenle sabit bir sağ-sol tanımı dalın özüne konamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya bakan yanını belirtir; salt sol, salt sağ, genel ön taraf ya da insanın kendisi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın insana dönük yan çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır. Hayvan ve yay uygulamaları bu çekirdeğin örneklenmesidir; yalnız bu kullanımlardan yeni bir genel yön anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin insana, kullanıcıya veya onun bulunduğu yöne bakan yanıdır. Hayvan ve yay üzerinde işlevsel ilişkiyle belirlenir; bu yanın sabit olarak sol ya da sağ sayılması konusunda aktarım uyuşmazlığı vardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin insana en yakın olan veya insana doğru bakan yanını belirtir.
Hayvanda binicinin bulunduğu, binme ve sağma işlemlerinde insana yakın olan yanı anlatır.
Yayda okçuya doğru bakan ve kullanıcının karşısında bulunan yanı anlatır.
İnsana yakın yan bazı aktarımda sol, başka bir aktarımda sağ diye belirlenir; yönün özü bu değişken tanımlardan bağımsızdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, nesnenin insana veya kullanıcıya dönük yanıdır; hayvanda biniciye, yayda okçuya göre belirlenir. İnsan bedenindeki tekil uygulamada öteki bacağa bakan yan kastedilir. Bu yanın solda mı sağda mı bulunduğuna ilişkin anlatımlar ayrıştığı için genel tanım sabit bir yön seçmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin yönü, ona yaklaşan veya onu kullanan insana göre belirlendiğinde dalın ortak çekirdeğini verir.

error_profile.preserves: Yanı sabit sağ veya sola bağlamadan insana göre yönelmiş olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın binme ve sağma sırasında insana yakın kalan yanı anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yanını biniciyle kurduğu işlevsel ilişkiye göre belirler.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yayın kullanım sırasında okçuya doğru dönük olan yüzü belirtilirken uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yay yüzünün yönünü okçunun konumuna göre belirleme özelliğini korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الإنسي الأيسر من كل شيء وقيل الأيمن وما أقبل منهما على الإنسان فهو إنسي وإنسي القوس ما أقبل عليك منها (sihah)؛ الإنسي من الدواب الجانب الأيسر الذي منه يركب ويحتلب ومن الإنسان الجانب الذي يلي الرجل الأخرى (tahdhib)؛ إنسي الدابة للجانب الذي يلي الراكب وإنسي القوس للجانب الذي يقبل على الرامي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Parmak ucu anlamı tek aktarım içinde eklenir ve gözdeki görüntünün kurucu parçası değildir; bağımlı bir kaynak varyantı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal göz bebeğinde görülen küçük görüntüyü, ayrıca ayrı bir aktarım olarak parmak ucunu kapsar; gözün kendisini veya genel insan türünü belirtmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dalın çekirdeği gözün kara bölümündeki küçük görüntüdür. Parmak ucu aktarımı bağımlı bir varyanttır; gözle ilgili belirli biçimlerden genel görüntü veya genel insan anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Gözün kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntü veya yansımadır. Ayrı bir kaynak kullanımında aynı ad parmak ucuna da verilir, ancak bu kullanım göz görüntüsü çekirdeğini değiştirmez.

facets.statement: Göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük insan biçimli görüntüyü veya yansımayı adlandırır.
Ayrı bir aktarımda parmak ucu veya eldeki parmak ucunu anlatan kullanım da aynı adla verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, göz bebeğinin kara bölümünde görülen küçük görüntüyü bir insan biçimi olarak tanımlar. Buna ek olarak parmak ucu anlamı da bildirilir, fakat bu ek kullanım gözdeki yansıma çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه إنسان العين: المثال أو الصبي الذي يرى في سواد العين، وما ألحقه تهذيب اللغة من الأنملة أو إنسان الكف.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki ayrı kalıplaşmış ilişkiyi açıkça ayırır: kişiye kendi durumunu soran sözde kişinin kendisi, bir başkasına bağlanan sözde ise seçilmiş yakın ve sırdaş kastedilir. Yakın arkadaş ve oturup konuşulan kişi için verilen paralel adlar ikinci alanı destekler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız eve giriş öncesindeki belirli söz çevresinde açıklanır. concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

concept_map.definition: Dua sonunda kabul edilme istegini bildiren ve 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' ya da 'bunu yap' anlaminda aciklanan sabit sozdur. Dal ayrica bu sozu soyleme eylemini ve kaynaklarda aktarılan ad yorumunu da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek, duada kabul istegini bildiren sabit cevap sozudur.
Kaynaklar sozun anlamini 'kabul et', 'oyle olsun' veya 'bunu yap' seklinde aciklar.
Bu sozu soyleme eylemi de ayni dal icinde adlandirilir.
Bazi aktarimlarda bu sozun ilahi bir ad oldugu yorumu da dalin yan rivayeti olarak bulunur.
